# PLAN — iteration 4
## Current state assessment
The verified incumbent is already timing-feasible at 7 LUTs and 9 FFs, so this iteration must strictly reduce LUTs (or tie LUTs and reduce FFs) to improve the objective. Iterations 1–3 were rejected: narrowing the counter changed behavior, and 32-bit counter update rewrites did not improve area. The current top’s numeric latency is unknown, so no annotation is required; preserve the full counter behavior and registered PWM output.

## Hypothesis
Expressing the PWM comparison as an explicit upper-bit zero check plus an 8-bit comparison may let Vivado map the duty comparator with fewer LUTs while preserving behavior for every 32-bit counter value.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the 32-bit counter, its synchronous active-high reset, and its existing conditional increment/wrap unchanged. Replace only `counter < {24'd0, duty}` with the equivalent condition `(counter[31:8] == 24'd0) && (counter[7:0] < duty)`. Preserve the registered `pwm_out` update and its reset behavior; the expected benefit is fewer LUTs, to be confirmed by routed utilization against the 7-LUT incumbent.
